items.name: Hummus
items.description: Creamy chickpea dip with tahini, lemon, and garlic, served with pita bread.

items.name: Falafel
items.description: Crispy fried chickpea patties with tahini sauce, served in pita with vegetables.

items.name: Greek Salad
items.description: Fresh salad with tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives, and feta cheese.

items.name: Chicken Shawarma
items.description: Marinated chicken cooked on a spit, served with garlic sauce and pita bread.

items.name: Moussaka
items.description: Layered eggplant dish with spiced ground meat and béchamel sauce.

items.name: Dolma
items.description: Grape leaves stuffed with rice, herbs, and sometimes meat.

items.name: Baklava
items.description: Sweet pastry made of layers of filo filled with chopped nuts and sweetened with syrup.

items.name: Tzatziki
items.description: Yogurt and cucumber dip with garlic and dill, perfect with pita or grilled meats.
